# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, Bounds
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import time

def solve():
    print("Loading network data...")
    with open('network.json') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    # --- Data Parsing ---
    bus_data = np.array(data['bus'])
    gen_data = np.array(data['gen'])
    branch_data = np.array(data['branch'])
    gencost_data = np.array(data['gencost'])
    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']

    # Map Bus IDs to 0-based indices
    bus_ids = bus_data[:, 0].astype(int)
    n_bus = len(bus_ids)
    bus_map = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

    # Constants
    BUS_I, TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN = range(13)
    F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX = range(13)
    GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN = range(10)
    
    # --- Ybus Construction ---
    # Convert scalar branch data to vectors
    f = np.array([bus_map[int(x)] for x in branch_data[:, F_BUS]])
    t = np.array([bus_map[int(x)] for x in branch_data[:, T_BUS]])
    r = branch_data[:, BR_R]
    x = branch_data[:, BR_X]
    b = branch_data[:, BR_B]
    tap = branch_data[:, TAP]
    shift = branch_data[:, SHIFT]
    status = branch_data[:, BR_STATUS]

    # Handle taps: 0 -> 1
    tap = np.where(tap == 0, 1.0, tap)
    # Convert shift to radians
    shift_rad = np.deg2rad(shift)
    
    # Series admittance
    z = r + 1j * x
    y_s = 1.0 / z
    y_s[status == 0] = 0  # Disconnected lines

    # Tap ratio (complex)
    # a = tap * exp(j * shift)
    # Yff = (ys + j*b/2) / |a|^2
    # Yft = -ys / conj(a)
    # Ytf = -ys / a
    # Ytt = ys + j*b/2

    bc = branch_data[:, BR_B]  # Charging susceptance
    
    a = tap * np.exp(1j * shift_rad)
    
    Yff = (y_s + 1j * bc / 2.0) / (np.abs(a) ** 2)
    Yft = -y_s / np.conj(a)
    Ytf = -y_s / a
    Ytt = (y_s + 1j * bc / 2.0)

    # Shunt admittance at buses
    # Ysh = Gs + j Bs (in MW, need pu?)
    # Usually Pd, Qd are in MW, Gs, Bs in MW (if using baseMVA)
    # Matpower: Gs, Bs are in MW at V=1.0 p.u. -> Ysh_pu = (Gs + j Bs) / baseMVA
    Ysh = (bus_data[:, GS] + 1j * bus_data[:, BS]) / baseMVA

    # Build Ybus matrix
    n_br = len(branch_data)
    
    # Off-diagonal elements
    row = np.concatenate([f, f, t, t])
    col = np.concatenate([f, t, f, t])
    data_y = np.concatenate([Yff, Yft, Ytf, Ytt])
    
    Ybus = csr_matrix((data_y, (row, col)), shape=(n_bus, n_bus))
    
    # Add diagonal shunts
    Ybus = Ybus + csr_matrix((Ysh, (np.arange(n_bus), np.arange(n_bus))), shape=(n_bus, n_bus))

    # --- Optimization Setup ---
    n_gen = len(gen_data)
    
    # Indices in state vector x
    # x = [Va (n_bus), Vm (n_bus), Pg (n_gen), Qg (n_gen)]
    idx_Va = np.arange(n_bus)
    idx_Vm = np.arange(n_bus, 2 * n_bus)
    idx_Pg = np.arange(2 * n_bus, 2 * n_bus + n_gen)
    idx_Qg = np.arange(2 * n_bus + n_gen, 2 * n_bus + 2 * n_gen)
    
    n_vars = 2 * n_bus + 2 * n_gen

    # Bounds
    # Va: -pi to pi (or unbound, usually loose)
    # Vm: Vmin to Vmax
    # Pg: Pmin to Pmax
    # Qg: Qmin to Qmax
    
    lb = np.zeros(n_vars)
    ub = np.zeros(n_vars)
    
    lb[idx_Va] = -np.pi
    ub[idx_Va] = np.pi
    
    lb[idx_Vm] = bus_data[:, VMIN]
    ub[idx_Vm] = bus_data[:, VMAX]
    
    lb[idx_Pg] = gen_data[:, PMIN]
    ub[idx_Pg] = gen_data[:, PMAX]
    
    lb[idx_Qg] = gen_data[:, QMIN]
    ub[idx_Qg] = gen_data[:, QMAX]
    
    # Reference bus: Lock Va = 0
    ref_bus_idx = np.where(bus_data[:, TYPE] == 3)[0] # Type 3 is ref
    if len(ref_bus_idx) > 0:
        # Constraint or tight bounds? Tight bounds are easier.
        ref_idx = ref_bus_idx[0]
        lb[idx_Va[ref_idx]] = 0.0
        ub[idx_Va[ref_idx]] = 0.0
    
    bounds = Bounds(lb, ub)

    # Initial Guess
    x0 = np.zeros(n_vars)
    x0[idx_Va] = 0.0 # Flat start
    x0[idx_Vm] = 1.0 # Flat start (or use existing Vm)
    # Use existing Vm if reasonable?
    # x0[idx_Vm] = bus_data[:, VM] 
    
    # For gens, start at P_gen mean or current
    x0[idx_Pg] = gen_data[:, PG]
    x0[idx_Qg] = gen_data[:, QG]

    # Pre-calculate gen mapping
    gen_bus_indices = np.array([bus_map[int(x)] for x in gen_data[:, GEN_BUS]])
    
    # Load vectors (pu)
    Pd_pu = bus_data[:, PD] / baseMVA
    Qd_pu = bus_data[:, QD] / baseMVA

    # Cost coefficients
    # gencost: [model, startup, shutdown, n, c2, c1, c0]
    # We assume n=3 (quadratic)
    cost_c2 = gencost_data[:, 4]
    cost_c1 = gencost_data[:, 5]
    cost_c0 = gencost_data[:, 6]

    # --- Objective Function ---
    def objective(x):
        Pg_val = x[idx_Pg] # In MW? No, usually constraints are PU but cost is on MW or PU?
        # Standard matpower: Cost is on MW (usually). 
        # Check: cost coefficients size. 
        # If typical, c2*P^2 + c1*P + c0 where P is MW.
        # But my x[idx_Pg] is better kept in MW? Or PU?
        # Let's keep x[idx_Pg] in MW to match limits and cost easily? 
        # OR keep x in PU and convert for cost.
        # It's cleaner to keep everything in PU for the solver (numerical stability).
        # So x[idx_Pg] is in PU.
        
        Pg_MW = Pg_val * baseMVA
        cost = np.sum(cost_c2 * Pg_MW**2 + cost_c1 * Pg_MW + cost_c0)
        return cost

    # --- Constraints ---
    def constraint_eq(x):
        Va_val = x[idx_Va]
        Vm_val = x[idx_Vm]
        Pg_val = x[idx_Pg] # PU
        Qg_val = x[idx_Qg] # PU
        
        # Reconstruct V
        V = Vm_val * np.exp(1j * Va_val)
        
        # Calculate Power Injections
        # S = V * conj(Ybus * V)
        # Using sparse matrix multiplication
        I_inj = Ybus.dot(V)
        S_inj = V * np.conj(I_inj)
        
        P_calc = np.real(S_inj)
        Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj)
        
        # P_gen - P_load = P_calc
        # But we need to map Generators to Buses
        # P_gen_bus = sum(Pg) at bus
        
        P_gen_bus = np.zeros(n_bus)
        np.add.at(P_gen_bus, gen_bus_indices, Pg_val)
        
        Q_gen_bus = np.zeros(n_bus)
        np.add.at(Q_gen_bus, gen_bus_indices, Qg_val)
        
        # Mismatch
        P_mismatch = P_gen_bus - Pd_pu - P_calc
        Q_mismatch = Q_gen_bus - Qd_pu - Q_calc
        
        return np.concatenate([P_mismatch, Q_mismatch])

    # Branch flow constraints (Inequality)
    # rateA is in MVA.
    # We need |S_ft| <= rateA/baseMVA
    
    # Filter branches with rateA > 0 (0 means unlimited)
    idx_constrained = np.where(branch_data[:, RATE_A] > 0)[0]
    rateA_pu = branch_data[idx_constrained, RATE_A] / baseMVA
    
    # Pre-calculate branch matrices for constrained branches

    t_c = t[idx_constrained]
    Yff_c = Yff[idx_constrained]
    Yft_c = Yft[idx_constrained]

        # S_ft = Vf * conj(Yff*Vf + Yft*Vt)
        I_ft = Yff_c * Vf + Yft_c * Vt

    start_time = time.time()
    
    # Using SLSQP
    res = minimize(
        objective, 
        x0, 
        method='SLSQP', 
        bounds=bounds, 
        constraints=constraints, 
        options={'maxiter': 200, 'ftol': 1e-4, 'disp': True}
    )
    
    end_time = time.time()
    print(f"Solver finished in {end_time - start_time:.2f}s")

    Va_opt = x_opt[idx_Va]
    Vm_opt = x_opt[idx_Vm]
    Pg_opt = x_opt[idx_Pg]
    Qg_opt = x_opt[idx_Qg]

        limit = branch_data[idx_lim, RATE_A]

    # Top loaded

    most_loaded = []
    for i in top_branches_idx:
        most_loaded.append({
            "from_bus": int(bus_ids[f[i]]),
            "to_bus": int(bus_ids[t[i]]),
            "loading_pct": round(float(loading_pct[i]), 1),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(float(np.abs(S_ft[i])), 1),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(float(np.abs(S_tf[i])), 1),
            "limit_MVA": float(branch_data[i, RATE_A]) if branch_data[i, RATE_A] > 0 else 0
        })

    # Summary
    total_cost = objective(x_opt)
    total_load_MW = np.sum(bus_data[:, PD])
    total_load_MVAr = np.sum(bus_data[:, QD])
    total_gen_MW = np.sum(Pg_opt * baseMVA)
    total_gen_MVAr = np.sum(Qg_opt * baseMVA)
    total_losses_MW = np.sum(Losses_MW)
    
    # Feasibility Check
    eq_res = constraint_eq(x_opt)
    max_p_mis = np.max(np.abs(eq_res[:n_bus])) * baseMVA
    max_q_mis = np.max(np.abs(eq_res[n_bus:])) * baseMVA
    
    # Voltage violation

    max_v_viol = np.max(np.maximum(v_viol_low, v_viol_high))

    max_br_overload = np.max(overload)

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(float(total_cost), 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(float(total_load_MW), 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(float(total_load_MVAr), 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(float(total_gen_MW), 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(float(total_gen_MVAr), 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(float(total_losses_MW), 2),
            "solver_status": "optimal" if res.success else "failed"
        },
        "generators": [],
        "buses": [],
        "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
        "feasibility_check": {

            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": float(max_q_mis),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_v_viol),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_br_overload)
        }
    }
    
    # Generators
    for i in range(n_gen):
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": i + 1,
            "bus": int(gen_data[i, GEN_BUS]),
            "pg_MW": round(float(Pg_opt[i] * baseMVA), 2),
            "qg_MVAr": round(float(Qg_opt[i] * baseMVA), 2),
            "pmin_MW": float(gen_data[i, PMIN]),
            "pmax_MW": float(gen_data[i, PMAX]),
            "qmin_MVAr": float(gen_data[i, QMIN]),
            "qmax_MVAr": float(gen_data[i, QMAX])
        })
        
    # Buses (Sample first 10 or all? Prompt example implies list. I'll include all or maybe truncated if huge?
    # The example shows 1 bus. "buses": [ { ... } ].
    # I'll include all buses.
    for i in range(n_bus):
        report["buses"].append({
            "id": int(bus_ids[i]),
            "vm_pu": round(float(Vm_opt[i]), 3),

            "vmin_pu": float(bus_data[i, VMIN]),

        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
    
    print("Report written to report.json")

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, Bounds
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, diags, hstack, vstack
import time

# --- Objective Function ---
    def objective(x):
        Pg_val = x[idx_Pg] # PU
        Pg_MW = Pg_val * baseMVA
        cost = np.sum(cost_c2 * Pg_MW**2 + cost_c1 * Pg_MW + cost_c0)
        return cost

    def objective_jac(x):
        Pg_val = x[idx_Pg]
        Pg_MW = Pg_val * baseMVA
        # dCost/dPg_pu = (2*c2*Pg_MW + c1) * baseMVA
        dCost_dPg = (2 * cost_c2 * Pg_MW + cost_c1) * baseMVA
        
        grad = np.zeros(n_vars)
        grad[idx_Pg] = dCost_dPg
        return grad

    # --- Constraints ---
    def constraint_eq(x):
        Va_val = x[idx_Va]
        Vm_val = x[idx_Vm]
        Pg_val = x[idx_Pg] # PU
        Qg_val = x[idx_Qg] # PU
        
        # Reconstruct V
        V = Vm_val * np.exp(1j * Va_val)
        
        # Calculate Power Injections
        # S = V * conj(Ybus * V)
        I_inj = Ybus.dot(V)
        S_inj = V * np.conj(I_inj)
        
        P_calc = np.real(S_inj)
        Q_calc = np.imag(S_inj)
        
        P_gen_bus = np.zeros(n_bus)
        np.add.at(P_gen_bus, gen_bus_indices, Pg_val)
        
        Q_gen_bus = np.zeros(n_bus)
        np.add.at(Q_gen_bus, gen_bus_indices, Qg_val)
        
        # Mismatch = P_gen - P_load - P_calc = 0
        P_mismatch = P_gen_bus - Pd_pu - P_calc
        Q_mismatch = Q_gen_bus - Qd_pu - Q_calc
        
        return np.concatenate([P_mismatch, Q_mismatch])

    def constraint_eq_jac(x):
        Va_val = x[idx_Va]
        Vm_val = x[idx_Vm]
        
        V = Vm_val * np.exp(1j * Va_val)
        
        # dS/dx
        # Standard formulations
        n = n_bus
        Ibus = Ybus.dot(V)
        diagV = diags(V)
        diagIbus = diags(Ibus)
        diagVnorm = diags(V / np.abs(V))
        
        # dS_dVa = j * diagV * (conj(diagIbus) - conj(Ybus) * conj(diagV))
        # Note: conj(A*B) = conj(A)*conj(B). 
        # But sparse logic:
        # term1 = diagV * diagIbus.conj()
        # term2 = diagV * Ybus.conj() * diagV.conj()
        # dS_dVa = 1j * (term1 - term2)
        
        term1 = diags(V * np.conj(Ibus)) # equivalent to diagV * diagIbus.conj()
        term2 = diagV.dot(Ybus.conj()).dot(diagV.conj()) # Careful with dot vs * for sparse
        
        dS_dVa = 1j * (term1 - term2)
        
        # dS_dVm = diagV * conj(Ybus) * conj(diagVnorm) + conj(diagIbus) * diagVnorm
        
        term3 = diagV.dot(Ybus.conj()).dot(diagVnorm.conj())
        term4 = diags(np.conj(Ibus) * (V / np.abs(V)))
        
        dS_dVm = term3 + term4
        
        # Jacobian of P_mismatch = P_gen - P_load - Re(S)
        # dP_mis / dVa = -Re(dS_dVa)
        # dP_mis / dVm = -Re(dS_dVm)
        # dQ_mis / dVa = -Im(dS_dVa)
        # dQ_mis / dVm = -Im(dS_dVm)
        
        # Also need wrt Pg, Qg
        # P_mis depends on Pg (+1 at gen bus)
        # Q_mis depends on Qg (+1 at gen bus)
        
        # Build sparse blocks
        # Rows: P (0..n-1), Q (n..2n-1)
        # Cols: Va, Vm, Pg, Qg
        
        J11 = -np.real(dS_dVa)
        J12 = -np.real(dS_dVm)
        J21 = -np.imag(dS_dVa)
        J22 = -np.imag(dS_dVm)
        
        # Gen blocks
        # dP_mis/dPg is a matrix (n_bus x n_gen) with 1s at (gen_bus, gen_id)
        # dQ_mis/dQg is similar
        
        row_gen = gen_bus_indices
        col_gen = np.arange(n_gen)
        data_gen = np.ones(n_gen)
        
        J_Pg = csr_matrix((data_gen, (row_gen, col_gen)), shape=(n_bus, n_gen))
        J_Qg = csr_matrix((data_gen, (row_gen, col_gen)), shape=(n_bus, n_gen))
        Z_gen = csr_matrix((n_bus, n_gen))
        
        # Construct full jacobian
        # [ J11, J12, J_Pg, Z_gen ]
        # [ J21, J22, Z_gen, J_Qg ]
        
        row1 = hstack([J11, J12, J_Pg, Z_gen])
        row2 = hstack([J21, J22, Z_gen, J_Qg])
        
        J = vstack([row1, row2])
        
        return J.toarray() # SLSQP expects dense array usually, or at least consistent with expectations

    # Branch flow constraints (Inequality)
    # rateA is in MVA.
    # We need |S_ft| <= rateA/baseMVA
    
    # Filter branches with rateA > 0 (0 means unlimited)
    idx_constrained = np.where(branch_data[:, RATE_A] > 0)[0]
    rateA_pu = branch_data[idx_constrained, RATE_A] / baseMVA
    
    # Pre-calculate branch matrices for constrained branches
    f_c = f[idx_constrained]
    t_c = t[idx_constrained]
    Yff_c = Yff[idx_constrained]
    Yft_c = Yft[idx_constrained]
    
    def constraint_ineq_flow(x):
        Va_val = x[idx_Va]
        Vm_val = x[idx_Vm]
        V = Vm_val * np.exp(1j * Va_val)
        
        Vf = V[f_c]
        Vt = V[t_c]
        
        # S_ft = Vf * conj(Yff*Vf + Yft*Vt)
        I_ft = Yff_c * Vf + Yft_c * Vt
        S_ft = Vf * np.conj(I_ft)
        
        return rateA_pu**2 - np.abs(S_ft)**2
    
    # Assemble constraints
    # equality: P, Q mismatch = 0
    # inequality: flow limit >= 0
    
    constraints = [
        {'type': 'eq', 'fun': constraint_eq, 'jac': constraint_eq_jac},
        {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': constraint_ineq_flow}
    ]

    print("Solving ACOPF...")
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # Using SLSQP
    res = minimize(
        objective, 
        x0, 
        method='SLSQP', 
        jac=objective_jac,
        bounds=bounds, 
        constraints=constraints, 
        options={'maxiter': 200, 'ftol': 1e-4, 'disp': True}
    )
